body:
在开放世界环境中测试AI自主科研能力，Station平均复现62.7%的论文发现，远超 Codex Multiagent-v2 的 15.4%，是当前最具说服力的比较基准

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08927
summary_en: Auto-generated draft note citing arXiv:2610.08927 on whether AI agents can make open-ended scientific discoveries. It claims that, in open-world tests of autonomous research ability, Station replicated an average of 62.7% of papers' findings, far exceeding Codex Multiagent-v2's 15.4%, calling this the most convincing comparative benchmark currently available. The figures rest solely on the cited source and remain unverified.
